reviews.title: Organized, but not really
reviews.text: This app seems like the best option for a registry because you can put everything on there, but unfortunately it causes more chaos than anything else. Because you can buy through multiple vendors, nothing comes organized or from who etc. I used this app for my baby shower and gifts would just arrive to my house in normal packaging (if it was packaged!) with maybe a label that mentioned who it was from ON THE BOX. They offer no gift wrap options, no easy way of returning items etc, you are much better off picking a registry on Amazon or Target that will make your returns and identifying the gifts easier. Unfortunate because it is a great idea, but the execution causes way more stress during a time you don’t need any.

reviews.title: HAWAII/Alaska: DON’T USE THIS APP!!
reviews.text:
Living in Hawaii I know we typically have added charges for shipping. When I signed up for babysit, I saw that all shipping is free if you spend $50+. I thought it was a good deal and went through with my registry. I received a Babylist gift card and as I was checking out, noticed the shipping fee didn’t disappear. In fact, the more I spent, the higher the fee went! When I dug a little deeper I found out that Alaska and Hawaii are not included in the $50 free shipping and they also charge more with the more money you spend! So now a majority of my $150 gift card was going right back to Babylist. Absolutely crazy. If
I knew this from the beginning I would have never used this app. No wonder all my guests kept asking about shipping! 
The few guests who purchased gifts via Babylist ALL had shipping issues. Not just one person, but every single one. Unacceptable. One friend was the first person to purchase off our registry and it’s been over 3 months and it’s still not here. At 2 months I reached out for a replacement or refund which they honored. It’s now been 3 months and I find out that replacement never went through and they needed to replace the replacement :( again, completely unacceptable customer service and business operations. They issued the original owner a refund but that’s it. 
I would suggest using any other app but Babylist if you live in Hawaii or Alaska!

reviews.title: COMPLETE RIP OFF
reviews.text: As a first time mom, I appreciated the direction and advice from the app on what to put on my registry. It was simple for me to add things both on Babylist and other stores, but that’s where is positives end. It was hard for purchasers to navigate. If you have people over 50 trying to use this app- avoid it. You’ll be overwhelmed with texts on how to use it. The shipment timing is SLOW AS $H!T. They regularly take a week after purchasing to even package something for shipment. They charge you return fees and take forever to process that too. For instance I had a $200 swing my baby hated. Returned it in the original packaging and everything and only got $87 back. AVOID this app. Just get a target registry. Honestly, the promo box from target was better anyways.

reviews.title: Awful customer service
reviews.text:
The app is good for the wishlist and tracking the orders, but awful for ordering breast pump and replacement parts. 

They get paid by insurance, so I expected the process would be nice and easy. 

You’re supposed to be able to order replacements parts once a month, but when you try doing it they tell you they haven’t gotten paid. At the meantime, on the insurance portal the payment was completed weeks back. You tell them, send screen shots but they can’t find the payment for weeks. 

And it keeps happening for as long as you use that for the purpose. Every month the same problem. I have United Healthcare, so it’s not like it’s some kind of smaller company difficult to locate the payment details from. 

Customer service keeps telling I’ll get an email about eligibility date for ordering new parts, but it never happens. Same problem few month in a row. 

The customers service people reply with random stuff - I emailed them about the updates on my order, they responded with what the app can be used for Completely unrelated to my question. I haven’t had such bad customer service for a really long time.

reviews.title: Shady business practice
reviews.text:
Shady business, beware and check your products received. They’ve remedied a lot of my missing orders in the past, our ups driver refuses to walk packages up to the third floor and leave them in the mail room
And we have someone who opens all the packages and takes what they want unfortunately. Someone purchased the rava next from my registry in Feb 2026 the rava next was released in Jan 2026.  The first problem was the incorrect address Babylist printed even though my correct address was listed on registry, so the item was lost in transit. When it showed up months later it was the old version of the rava. Although the older version rava was never advertised to me, nor on my Registry on babylist they lied and said the gift giver selected the rava and not the rava next. They also charged the gift giver for the rava next even tho the rava was now cheaper bc its an older version.  To me
It’s obvious they sent the older version to get rid of the older product they’d have sitting in backstock since the new one was just released. While the gift giver was refunded after a week they now want the car seat back after it finally arrived and I said it was the wrong product to begin with, and I’m out of a car seat for my baby right now, who’s grown out of his infant car seat

reviews.title: Worst Baby Registry Ever
reviews.text:
FTM and decided to use this to help me with creating my registry. 
1. There’s not much selection.
2. If you return items it becomes store credit.
3. You have the chance of never receiving your items at all. 
4. Most never come on time for those that don’t want to spend the extra money on expediting there items.
Been waiting for almost 2 months and half for a diaper genie, and still have heard no updates on my item since.
Overall would definitely have gone with something else, if anyone is deciding to use Babylist for their registry.

reviews.title: Terrible App
reviews.text:
Babylist is honestly one of the most frustrating platforms I’ve used. The idea is great, but the execution is terrible. Gift cards are basically useless unless you want to overpay for everything in their store, which completely defeats the purpose of having a flexible registry.

The site is confusing, not user-friendly, and makes simple things like searching or reviewing items way harder than they should be. It feels like everything is designed to push you into their overpriced marketplace.

I would not recommend using Babylist — there are much easier and more transparent registry options out there.
